   101→		return blocks.NewVerifiedROBlob(bv.blob), nil

   103→	return blocks.VerifiedROBlob{}, bv.results.errors(ErrBlobInvalid)

   106→// SatisfyRequirement allows the caller to assert that a requirement has been satisfied.
